# Third AI Commercials

> Generative AI advertising studio in Haripad, Alappuzha, Kerala. We make AI TV commercials, AI video ads and brand films, plus AI automation (WhatsApp assistants, voice agents, workflow automation) for businesses across Kerala and India.

## Services

- [AI Ad Services](https://thirdaicommercials.com/#ads): AI TV commercials, AI product ads, AI fashion campaigns, AI brand films, AI UGC videos and AI motion graphics, made in Malayalam and English. Our AI commercials have aired on Kerala TV channels including Asianet News, Manorama News, Mathrubhumi News, 24 News, MediaOne and Reporter TV.
- [AI Automation Services](https://thirdaicommercials.com/#automation): AI WhatsApp and chat assistants, AI voice agents, lead capture and follow-up, reports, and workflow/CRM automation built with tools like n8n.
- [FAQ](https://thirdaicommercials.com/#faq): Answers on turnaround time, pricing approach, Malayalam-language ads, automation scope, and areas served.
- [Contact](https://thirdaicommercials.com/#contact): Phone and WhatsApp +91 95391 01061, email Thirdaicommercials@gmail.com.

## Company

Third AI Commercials LLP is based in Haripad, Alappuzha, Kerala, India, and works with businesses across Kerala, including Kochi, Thiruvananthapuram, Kozhikode, Kollam and Kottayam.
